content:
maria: Heads-up — hotfix PR for router latency spike is ready, needs review/merge + canary watch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/1985

deploy-bot: CI queued for PR #1985 — running tests and perf job

oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2026-03-17: router latency spike detected 2026-03-17T08:12Z, error rate +3.2%. Affected 3 customer routes. Pager already notified.

alex: taking a look now. which code area is this touching?

samir: root cause is conn-pool backpressure change -> callers were getting transient errors and retry storms. This PR caps inflight per backend and adds kv-cache fallback. Key diff:
```
- reqs.inflight++
+ if (reqs.inflight >= MAX_PER_BACKEND) return fallbackKV(req)
```

maria: unit tests added but one flaky test in perf suite failing on CI: `router_perf.TestBurstLatency` — looks like timing tolerance.

ryan: I can review. request: add a small sleep tolerance or use mocked clock in the test. Will also check for race.

alex: noted. can we get a snapshot of prod metrics pre/post? run `scripts/metrics/snapshot --last 10m` and attach.

samir: attached output (trimmed):
```
router.latency.p95: 420ms -> 260ms (after canary)
router.errors.rate: 0.32 -> 0.03
```

maria: rollback PR created in case canary shows regressions: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/1986 (revert + feature flag)

oncall-bot: canary rollout started to 5% of traffic at 2026-03-17T08:40Z. Autoscale watch enabled.

ryan: left review comments. small nit in error log string and test change requested. once tests green i'm happy to approve.

maria: CI green on most jobs, perf flaky re-run in progress. tagging @ryan @alex for approvals, target merge in 10–15m if green.

alex: approved from my side, no objections.

ryan: approved after test fix. merging now.

deploy-bot: Merge detected for PR #1985 into hotfix/latency-2026-03-17 by ryan. Deploy started: canary -> 5%.

maria: canary looks healthy after 12m, p95 down to ~240ms. keeping at 25% for another 30m then full rollout if stable. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

samir: added postmortem stub in #incidents, will flesh out timeline. if anything weird pop it here.

oncall-bot: Watching policy active. Alerts will post here if thresholds exceeded.

alex: good work. moving to monitor shift.

maria: closing thread. ping if anything else.
